abilities.metaTitle: Pokémon Abilities — Effects & Which Pokémon Have Them
abilities.metaDescription: Browse every Pokémon ability with its in-battle effect, and see which Pokémon have it as a normal or hidden ability.
abilities.blurb: What each ability does and every Pokémon that has it.

moves.metaTitle: Pokémon Moves — Power, Accuracy, PP & Who Learns Them
moves.metaDescription: Every Pokémon move with type, category, power, accuracy and PP. Filter by type and category, then see which Pokémon learn each one.

items.metaTitle: Pokémon Items — Effects, Held Items & TMs
items.metaDescription: Every item from the main Pokémon games: effects, categories, wild Pokémon that hold them, and the moves TMs, TRs and HMs teach.
items.blurb: Items from the main games: effects, who holds them in the wild, and which move each TM teaches.
